title: Scream if you Wanna Go Faster
description:
You're driving, and I'm your passenger princess, sitting beside you and encouraging you to speed up as I drop you into trance. Since trance is like driving after all. Now every time you speed up you say my name louder, and the louder you say it the better my hand guiding yours up and down feels.

Let's go really fast together baby, and be first across that finish line as you finish, and scream Calia at the top of your lungs.

Art by Celyn.

This file has haptic feedback enabled. To set your device up, use this page .

If you don't have one, order a haptic-enabled device from Lovense with my affiliate link to help me out!
author: Mistress Calia
